category_title: Adolescent with emotional/behavioral disorder and academic frustration
scenario_title: Independent mathematics assignment and quiz completion
minimal_context: Isaac is sitting at his desk during class time to complete an independent math quiz on a tablet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Isaac, it is time for your independent math assignment. Please log into the tablet and complete the quiz questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is a waste of time. I'm not doing these stupid math problems.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to finish the assignment. Just do your best.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't do it! I don't know these facts! (Scribbles aggressively all over his assignment paper)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, Isaac. Look at the next question on the tablet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I said I'm not doing it! (Grabs the tablet and throws it onto the floor, breaking it, then tears a page out of his math book)
